Senses.Explanation: The river-loss saying sends the search back to the place of loss: if money was lost in the river, search that river. The corpus preserves the answer under both Lingyun Zhiqin and Yunmen Wenyan; Shending Yikui later uses the same line in an address, so the conflicting inherited attribution remains visible. Complete-unit reading distinguishes original utterance, later raising, verse/commentary, biography, and paratext, and controls duplicate recensions at the deployment-family level.
